name: What is the first step before planning a room addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step before planning a room addition in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the first step before planning a room addition in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring for detailed design, homeowners should confirm what the property can legally and structurally support. A feasibility review checks zoning, setbacks, lot coverage, height limits, utility placement, and basic site constraints. It also helps identify whether the existing foundation and framing can handle the new load. This step prevents expensive redesigns after plans are already underway. Once feasibility is clear, the next steps are concept design, engineering, cost estimating, and permit preparation. Homeowners should also think about how the addition will affect daily life during construction, including access, parking, noise, and temporary room loss. Starting with the right constraints makes the rest of the project much smoother and keeps the budget grounded in reality.
acceptedAnswer.description: The first step is a feasibility check to confirm zoning, setbacks, lot coverage, and structural constraints before spending money on detailed plans. This helps determine whether the desired addition is actually allowed and what design options are realistic.
